description: Document analyzer – extracts text, structure, and key-value pairs from documents (PDF, DOCX, etc.)

Summary.description: A concise summary of the document's overall content and purpose

KeyPhrases.description: Key phrases and terms extracted from the document

NamedEntities.description: Named entities identified in the document as a comma-separated list of 'Text (Category)' pairs, e.g. 'Alice (Person), London (Location), Acme Corp (Organization)'

PiiData.description: Any personally identifiable information detected in the document (names, SSNs, account numbers, addresses); null if none

AnyAnomaly.description: Description of any anomaly detected in the document (inconsistencies, suspicious content, signs of tampering); null if none

Classification.description: Hierarchical classification of the document content (up to 3 levels deep)

Category.description: Top-level category of the document (e.g. Legal, Financial, Medical, Technical, HR)

Subcategory.description: Second-level classification within the category (e.g. Contract, Invoice, LabReport, UserManual, JobOffer)

Tag.description: Third-level specific tag within the subcategory (e.g. NDA, PurchaseOrder, BloodTest, API, OfferLetter)
